parameter_completeness: Original complete plans are retained by whole path/bytes/SHA256/Git blob, including every candidate, direction, original argv, expected profile/core, domain/layout rule and source/input map. Inlined owned-resource objects are complete. The original source parser/constants supply the exact construction definition; no unrecorded historical invocation is invented.
known_downstream_consumers_and_exact_res: Grid files are generated scientific observations, and are real inputs to historical finite-field/minimax/readers. Retiring them does not declare them unused: every such reader must receive the exact fixed original file before use. Counts or new samples cannot replace them.
The five-regression report is a real source input of the retained combined-regression plan. Restore exactly dc2885... before invoking that historical plan.

The r2/r3 receipts are later read by the historical archive assembler while it recursively embeds their original plans. Both full recovered plans remain retained in the live tree; the exact receipt whole bytes are additionally recoverable directly from Git and through the full nineteen-field gzip recipe.
The dedup report is an administrative output. Its producer and original owned lifecycle records remain; no duplicate scientific payload is removed by this batch.

The carrier curvature report is a conditional numerical budget. Its original formal report, resource, upstream identities and proof remain exactly restorable; no downstream proof may drop its same-field/full-error hypothesis.
current_runtime_separation: The active fixed-Fejer source/recipe/scalar/node/reference/field families, all current run inputs, source manifests, command/queue/ready objects, typed/history records and exact parameter choices are outside the deletion list. This proposal does not change those mathematical inputs or claim that a legacy observation proves a current field condition.
original_failure_and_unknown_preservatio: Original q095 external 4752-byte client is still not recovered; the longer same-name mirror is not an alias. Original core-tail-proxy source-version distinction remains exactly as retention51.

Nine original runner-only numpy gzip payload identities are listed explicitly as not newly recovered, with full original paths and whole SHA. They are not deleted. Exact recovery of every selected output uses its immutable Git blob and does not rely on regenerating those payloads.

Missing live scratch chunk files, unknown tool-session exits, original invalid control-name failure and original misspelled plan-path failure remain recorded. A completed preparation is not an actual field evaluation or accepted solution.
No candidate raw/binary body, numerical field or large gzip was opened for this review; no scientific run, solve, fixture, AST/compile or numerical replay was performed.

exact_restoration.verify: Compare full bytes, SHA-256 and Git blob with the candidate record before historical consumption. This is direct byte restoration, not scientific regeneration.
exact_restoration.scientific_recompute: Only an authorized runner may perform a new scientific replay after all exact original inputs and source versions are available. New computed outputs are not automatically the archived original bytes; lifecycle receipts are restored from Git rather than regenerated from changed process state.
